 One Piece has been delivering knockout chapters for the last several weeks, but Chapter 1197, "Love Is Defense" might be a cut above. Following from Sanji's growing recognition of selfhood, he achieves a pinnacle against a Knight of God. This is the second consecutive chapter to focus exclusively on one character; the results are nothing short of spectacular.

 Decades after fans have grown to love Sanji, Oda continues to make his evolution matter. While the Final Saga's impending demands will eventually force all the Straw Hats to break their limits, it's always a celebration when a fan-favorite passes the test and becomes a better version of themselves.
 "Love Is Defense" Is a Superb One Piece Culmination
 Close Sanji attacks Killingham in One Piece Chapter 1197 Image via Shueisha 
 Sanji smacks Killingham around Elbaph in One Piece Chapter 1197 Image via Shueisha 
 Sanji remembers his struggles in One Piece Chapter 1197 Image via Shueisha 
 Sanji acknowledges Ivankov in One Piece Chapter 1197 Image via Shueisha 
 Sanji, who persistently refused to tolerate his blood connection to the Vinsmokes, had internalized that hatred. He believed that he was as worthless as his brothers, weapons of apathetic evil forged by Vinsmoke Garuda in his desperate bid to create a dynasty. Sanji's rivalry with Zoro featured strongly arrogant tendencies, but none of those claims were actually serious, further disguising what he genuinely felt about himself.
 Even a cursory glance at Sanji's character arc exposes the truth. Reframing his self-hatred as self-sacrifice, he continued to harm himself more than necessary. Ivankov's lessons in the Kamabakka Queendom bled through during Sanji's fight with Rimoshifu Killingham, setting him on a journey he never imagined. In the last chapter, he accepted his worth and took his first steps toward self-love.

 Chapter 1197 is a crescendo of epiphanies, as Sanji grapples with the past, overcomes the present, and builds a path to the future. Killingham's comebacks are brutally dismantled, with Sanji unconsciously leaking Conqueror's Haki into his attacks while simultaneously rifling through memories that converge at a singular realization: "My first priority should be to preserve my own life."
 The "sense of self" demanded by Conqueror's Haki transformed into an expression of self-love, allowing Sanji to consciously become one of the very few Supreme Kings in the One Piece world. Doom will come as quickly for Killingham as for Sommers, with both Knights of God having no choice but to beg for their lives.
 Elaborated by the chapter's title, Ivankov's "Love should power your defense" is already one of the best One Piece quotes, a simple line that crystallizes the manga's entire philosophy. As for Sanji, love and life are finally the same thing. He now knows that power can only come from the self.
 Sanji Catches Up with Zoro in One Piece Chapter 1197
 Sanji tells Zoro to be Luffy's sword in One Piece Chapter 1197 Image via Shueisha 
 Anime rivals are naturally implied to be on par with each other: Naruto-Sasuke, Goku-Vegeta, Asta-Yuno, and many other pairings fuel their individual ascensions. Sometimes, one of them manages to outpace the other, and One Piece fans have long wondered how that trope applies to Zoro and Sanji.
 Zoro has remained on top for the longest time, whether in terms of reputation, bounty, or recorded feats. Sanji's accomplishments were admittedly impressive, but he languished behind his rival. As One Piece 's Final Saga propels forward, however, Oda might be deciding to equalize these two.
 Related 
 One Piece Crowns Its Third Straw Hat with Conqueror's Haki
 Both of Luffy's lieutenants can now use Conqueror's Haki, bringing him ever closer to Pirate Kingship.
 Posts 
 By  
 Ajay Aravind 
 The first clue comes in the portrayal of Scopper Gaban's combat prowess. As Sanji's Left-Hand counterpart, earning Imu's respect is a testament to terrifying power. Silvers Rayleigh may have been Gol D. Roger's Right Hand, but the Pirate King was clearly ambidextrous. Secondly, Sanji acquired a devastating ability mere moments after his rival.
 Even if Zoro defeated King with Conqueror's Haki, he couldn't consciously exploit it until he remembered Mihawk's basic definition. Chapter 1194 concluded when Zoro learned to control and manifest this power, and just three chapters later, Sanji performed an identical feat. Although their paths were radically different, the Left and Right Hands of Monkey D. Luffy are seemingly on the same level.
 While it might take longer for Mosshead and Pervy Cook to both acknowledge their equality, at least Sanji recognized Zoro as Luffy's "sword" in Chapter 1197. He then proclaims himself to be Luffy's "shield," unleashing a Conqueror's Haki attack that has left fans debating endlessly.
 One Piece Fan Theories Never Stop About Conqueror's Haki
 Sanji remembers Ivankov in One Piece Chapter 1197 Image via Shueisha 
 Based on Chapter 1197, it looks like Sanji has infused his leg with Conqueror's Haki, or CoC. Black lightning symbolizes the Supreme King, although the color of his flames may not be obvious until the anime. Infusion is an Advanced CoC technique, employed by Roger, Garp, Luffy, Whitebeard, Xebec, Shanks, and other One Piece powerhouses , putting Sanji on their level.
 That said, a few fans suspect his upgrade to be something different, a purely defensive technique that Sanji summarized as "receiving a hit feels like landing it." The usually offensive CoC coatings could have transformed into a brand-new ability, allowing him to take significantly more damage. It's an ironic outcome, considering the whole lesson was to love himself. It works perfectly, though, because now he effectively has two power-ups: Conqueror's Haki and the determination to protect his body.

 Another theory takes Sanji's eyebrow changes into account. Chapter 1197 shows the Germa-related orientation before returning to its original curl when he embraces his identity. This could symbolize a severance between Sanji and his toxic family, whose eyebrow patterns curl in the opposite direction. On the other hand, the status of his genetic modifications — potentially eyebrow-linked — remain unclear.
 Arguably the best foreshadowing in "Love Is Defense," Zoro and Sanji being the spear and shield carried by Nika cements them as critical elements in finding the One Piece and saving the world. Luffy himself would never need to wield these weapons, allowing his Right and Left Hands to protect him and preserve his dream. Ultimately, One Piece is an eternal reminder that, no matter the obstacle, the Straw Hats will inevitably overcome it together.
